TidyTuesday Metadata

Source: R/tidytuesday_meta.R
tidytuesday_meta.Rd

A dataset of TidyTuesday posts with YAML metadata, code metrics, and plot image names.

Usage

tidytuesday_meta

Format

A tibble with columns:

file_path

Path to the .qmd file in the repo

title

Title from YAML

date

Date of the post

categories

Categories from YAML

image

Plot image file name from plot_name object

num_lines

Number of code lines

num_comments

Number of comment lines

functions_used

List of functions called in the code

packages

List of packages loaded

plot_types

List of geom types used

Source

https://github.com/colebaril/tidytuesday
